meta_description: Ventana Breeze by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Highlights: 📍 Village at Blue Mountain Beach 🏝️ 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Access 🛏️ 3 bedrooms, 3 baths 🛺 Six-seater golf
description_expanded:
Village at Blue Mountain Beach

1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Access

3 bedrooms, 3 baths

Six-seater golf cart

Community pool!

3 bikes!

4-star restaurants

Lots of shops

Ventana Breeze by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to Ventana Breeze located in the Ventana Dunes, a charming cottage community with a community pool, no through traffic, and just a mile to public beach access. Guests can bike from this central location to the public beach access on S. County Highway 83, as well as several local eateries including Blue Mabel Smokehouse, Johnny McTighes Irish Pub, and Blue Mountain Bakery. Everyone will be happy with a stop at Blue Mountain Creamery for the best house-made ice cream this end of 30A. Ventana Breeze is a spectacular home located in Blue Mountain Beach. There is 1 master suite and 2 guest bedrooms which all have TVs.

The spacious living room has a flat-screen TV. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the dining area and the fully-stocked kitchen with the living space. The guest room downstairs includes a comfy king bed and private bath. There is a lovely patio in the back of the home with seating for 4 and a gas grill. The 2nd floor has both a king master bedroom with private bath and a two twin over full bunk beds in the guest room with private bath. Come down and relax your mind at Ventana Breeze! We are excited to have you stay with us! Oversee Rentals is a small locally owned company comprised of hard-working professionals passionate about providing a clean home and consistent experience for our guests. Our local office is located within 10 miles of this home. We are open seven days a week and operate a 24/7 emergency line. If you need anything during your stay, please let us know. We are right down the street and are happy to head your way! Overview: - 1 mile to beach (Blue Mountain Access) - 1.6 miles to Ed Walline Public Beach Access - 3 bedroom, 3 bath - 1558 square feet - community pool - gas grill - Wi-Fi - golf cart included - 3 bikes included Overnight: FIRST FLOOR Guest Room: King bed; private bath; TV SECOND FLOOR Primary Bedroom: King bed; private bath Bunkroom: Two twin over full bunk beds; TV Check-in is at 4:00 PM CST and checkout is at 10:00 AM CST
